integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus of an algebraic C* action; projectivity identifies compactly supported and ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 0801.3074 gives first submission date 2008-01-20.
integrity.fixed_locus_basis: Under t.[x:y]=[tx:y], a fixed projective point cannot have both coordinates nonzero; both coordinate projective subspaces lie in the commuting variety.
integrity.object_basis: Popov and Richardson study the same affine commuting variety of pairs satisfying the Lie-bracket equation.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: Popov's archival record lists 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification 14M99 first.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes ordinary Euler characteristic only; it does not determine singularities, irreducibility, Betti numbers, intersection cohomology, or mixed Hodge structure.
Subvarieties with nilpotency, rank, or orbit-closure restrictions have different fixed loci and require separate analysis.
The one-parameter-group proof is short, so an older unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: The projectivized commuting variety has the ambient Euler characteristic
